courses.title: Python for AI Engineers
courses.description: Build your Python foundation specifically for AI/ML workflows. Master NumPy, Pandas, and data manipulation with real Indian dataset examples.

courses.title: Mathematics for Machine Learning
courses.description: Master Linear Algebra, Calculus, Probability and Statistics — the mathematical foundation every ML engineer must own. IIT-level content made accessible.

courses.title: Prompt Engineering Mastery
courses.description: Go from basic ChatGPT user to professional prompt engineer. Learn chain-of-thought, few-shot prompting, and system prompt design for production AI apps.

courses.title: Transformers: From Attention to GPT-4
courses.description: Implement the Transformer architecture from scratch in PyTorch. Understand self-attention, multi-head attention, positional encoding, and BERT/GPT architectures at the code level.

courses.title: RAG Systems: Build Production LLM Apps
courses.description: Build production-ready Retrieval-Augmented Generation pipelines. Combine vector databases, embedding models, and LLMs to create AI apps that know your data.

courses.title: AI Agents with LangGraph
courses.description: Build stateful, multi-step AI agents using LangGraph. Create autonomous systems that can plan, execute tools, and adapt to real-world feedback loops.

courses.title: MLOps: Deploy AI to Production
courses.description: Build end-to-end ML pipelines with CI/CD, model monitoring, and automated retraining. Deploy models on AWS/GCP used by Indian SaaS companies.

courses.title: Vector Databases & Semantic Search
courses.description: Master Pinecone, Weaviate, Chroma, and pgvector. Build semantic search, recommendation engines, and knowledge bases for enterprise AI applications.

courses.title: Fine-Tuning & RLHF for LLMs
courses.description: Fine-tune Llama 3, Mistral, and Gemma using LoRA, QLoRA, and RLHF. Build domain-specific AI models for Indian language understanding and business applications.

courses.title: AI Product Management
courses.description: Learn to define, prioritize, and ship AI features as a product manager. Understand model capabilities, bias risks, and how to write AI specs for engineering teams.

courses.title: Building AI Startups in India
courses.description: From idea to investor pitch: how to build defensible AI startups in the Indian market. Includes funding landscape, DPIIT registration, and GTM for Bharat.

courses.title: AI Automation for Business Leaders
courses.description: Automate business workflows using no-code/low-code AI tools. Build internal chatbots, automate reports, and integrate AI into existing enterprise systems without coding.
